LLM review advisory disposition, patch set 2 (18f58da6241f7ed73c1af3259091e5bcb4682721):
- Valid/remediated: replaced the stale-prone hardcoded 1,383 conversion count in the hardening docstring with an invariant statement.
- Valid/remediated: added a direct ReplayRecorder nondeterminism test. Defect-seeded mutation deleting the comparison produced the expected DID NOT RAISE failure; restored implementation passes.
- Valid/remediated: added a direct pass-3 non-settlement test. Defect-seeded mutation deleting the guard produced the expected DID NOT RAISE failure; restored implementation passes.
- Rejected as an intended contract, not a defect: frozen platform-binary fingerprints intentionally make runner/binary drift fail even if output happens to remain equal. ADR 0096 decisions 4-5 and docs/architecture.md require this fail-fast provenance behavior. Patch set 1 current Ubuntu/macOS provenance gates passed, confirming the hashes match current hosted runners. No weakening or follow-on ticket is appropriate.

Validation: 22 generator tests passed; both mutation checks failed for the intended reason then returned GREEN after restore; make lint/actionlint/complexity passed; mypy passed 540 files; commit hooks passed. Rebased onto current origin/main 56509ee5f7 before push.
